page.overview:
Who is Baksan?

Baksan was a male Rutian Twi'lek seen on Batuu. He used the title "Mayor."

Concept art of Baksan, a character that potentially could have been a part of Disney's Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge themed land, was created by Andrew Domachowski and later appeared in The Art of Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge.
